samplePosition: x=minX+column*dx; z=minZ+row*dz; both grid edges included

qualityClasses.1: GSI DEM5A z14 bilinear resample (~7.78 m input pixel)
qualityClasses.2: GSI numeric DEM z12 bilinear fallback (~31 m input pixel)
qualityClasses.3: nearest measured grid sample filled because all numeric inputs missing

notes: Elevation already in metres: do not multiply y by Mercator correction.
Horizontal local projection uses WGS84 ellipsoid; x,z are metre distances, not raw EPSG:3857 units.
DEM measures macro topography; does not resolve rock/root microrelief or cave voids.
Mask value 3 flags every nodata fill; no unflagged invented terrain.
